pages.title: An exact frozen-voltage gate step
pages.text:
An exact frozen-voltage gate step
For ks = αs + βs > 0,
sn+1 = s∞ + (sn − s∞)e−ks∆t.
This is a convex combination of sn and s∞ for nonnegative rates.
Computational Cardiology Notes 11 / 20

The zero-rate limit

No equilibrium fraction needs to be formed by

pages.title: Current cancellation at rest
pages.text:
Current cancellation at rest
Individual ionic currents can remain nonzero while their sum vanishes.
The companion
recomputes the equilibrium from its exact rate constants, near −69.89767 mV.

pages.title: Excitation depends on the protocol
pages.text:
Excitation depends on the protocol
Pulse amplitude, duration, initial voltage and initial gates jointly determine the response.
A zero-crossing distinction for one pulse does not deﬁne a universal excitation threshold.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 20

pages.title: Model identity
pages.text:
Model identity
These neuronal kinetics describe a speciﬁc V, m, h, n system.
A reduced cardiac model
changes both the variables and the equations; it is not obtained by relabeling a neuronal
trace.
